_note: Metric definitions for the dashboard. One canonical id per measured quantity per platform family. 'kind': count (summable within one account and platform over days), daily (a per-day count of people who recur across days, e.g. daily players: shown per day or as an average per day, never summed), rate (never summed; shown as given), level (a point-in-time total such as followers; never summed over days), money. 'stage' is the funnel measurement stage; stages are separate populations and are never divided into each other.

stages.label: Interest
stages.measures: Profile visits, follows and link activity

stages.label: Acquisition
stages.measures: New players and attributable referral traffic

stages.label: Retention
stages.measures: Returning players, D1/D7 retention and sessions

metrics.label: Views
metrics.definition: Each platform's own view count. Definitions differ (YouTube counts a view differently from TikTok and Instagram), so views are never added across platforms.

metrics.label: Reach
metrics.definition: Instagram: unique accounts that saw the content (estimated by Instagram). Unique within the period and account only.

metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.definition: YouTube thumbnail impressions (Studio export only; not in the Analytics API).

metrics.label: Watch time
metrics.definition: Total minutes watched. YouTube: estimatedMinutesWatched. Instagram: ig_reels_video_view_total_time converted from ms. Not offered by the TikTok Display API.

metrics.label: Avg view duration
metrics.definition: Average seconds watched per view (YouTube averageViewDuration; Instagram ig_reels_avg_watch_time; TikTok only by manual import from TikTok Studio).

metrics.label: Avg % viewed
metrics.definition: YouTube averageViewPercentage: average share of the video watched per view. Can exceed 100 on looping Shorts.

metrics.label: Watched full video
metrics.definition: TikTok Studio 'watched full video' percentage (manual import only).

metrics.label: Likes
metrics.definition: Platform like count.

metrics.label: Comments
metrics.definition: Platform comment count.

metrics.label: Shares
metrics.definition: Platform share count.

metrics.label: Saves
metrics.definition: Saves or favourites (Instagram 'saved'; TikTok favourites by manual import).

metrics.label: Profile visits
metrics.definition: Profile views attributed to the item or account, as the platform reports them (manual import where no API metric exists).

metrics.label: Link taps
metrics.definition: Taps on the profile or video link (Instagram profile_links_taps; others by manual import).

metrics.label: Followers
metrics.definition: Followers or subscribers at the observation time. YouTube rounds public subscriber counts. Never added across platforms: one person can follow several accounts.

metrics.label: Followers gained
metrics.definition: New followers in the period (YouTube subscribersGained; Instagram follows; TikTok by manual import).

metrics.label: Followers lost
metrics.definition: Unfollows in the period (YouTube subscribersLost; Instagram unfollows).

metrics.label: Link visits
metrics.definition: Roblox share link: users who reached the experience details page through the link (Creator Dashboard; manual import).

metrics.label: New players via link
metrics.definition: New players Roblox credits to the tracked share link used for this upload (Creator Dashboard, entered by hand). Only attributable when each upload has its own link.

metrics.label: New players
metrics.definition: Roblox DailyActiveUsers with IsNewUser = new: players whose first visit was that day. Not attributable to a video unless they arrived through a tracked share link.

metrics.label: Players with sessions
metrics.definition: Roblox UniqueUsersWithPlaySessions; broken down by AcquisitionSource where requested.

metrics.label: Onboarding step users
metrics.definition: Roblox FunnelStepTotalCount for the onboarding funnel. Needs in-game AnalyticsService events (proposal, not implemented).

metrics.label: Daily players
metrics.definition: Roblox DailyActiveUsers. Days are not added together (the same player returns on several days); shown per day.

metrics.label: D1 retention
metrics.definition: Roblox ForwardD1Retention for players whose first day was that date. A cohort rate, never averaged across days without cohort sizes.

metrics.label: D7 retention
metrics.definition: Roblox ForwardD7Retention for that day's cohort.

metrics.label: D30 retention
metrics.definition: Roblox ForwardD30Retention for that day's cohort.

metrics.label: Avg session
metrics.definition: Roblox AverageSessionLengthMinutes.

metrics.label: Visits
metrics.definition: Roblox Visits (Analytics Query API, per day) or the public lifetime visit total (legacy games API, a level).

metrics.label: Playing now
metrics.definition: Concurrent players at the observation moment (legacy public games API).

metrics.label: Favourites
metrics.definition: Lifetime favourite count (legacy public games API).

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.definition: Roblox DailyRevenue in Robux as reported (all revenue sources). Not converted to currency.

metrics.label: Payers
metrics.definition: Roblox PayingUsers per day. Days are not added together.

metrics.label: Payer conversion
metrics.definition: Roblox PayingUsersCVR: payers divided by players, both in Roblox's own population for that day.

metrics.label: Production time
metrics.definition: Minutes the owner spent producing the asset (entered by hand).
